cases.explain: Притчи is the nominative plural subject in the title.

cases.translation: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
cases.explain: After начало (beginning), the genitive shows relationship.

cases.translation: My son, listen to the instruction of your father.
cases.explain: After послушай (listen to), the genitive case is used.

cases.sentence: Они будут прекрасным ___ на твоей голове.
cases.translation: They will be a beautiful garland on your head.
cases.explain: After будут (will be), the instrumental case is used for predicate.

cases.translation: And a necklace around your neck.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Идем с нами, устроим ___ для пролития крови.
cases.translation: Come with us, let's set an ambush to shed blood.
cases.explain: Засаду (ambush) is the direct object of устроим (we will set up).

cases.sentence: Устроим засаду для пролития ___, без причины подстережем.
cases.translation: Let's set up an ambush to shed blood.
cases.explain: After для (for purpose), the genitive case shows intent.

cases.sentence: Как бессмысленно ставить ___ на глазах у птиц.
cases.translation: How foolish to set a net in the sight of birds.
cases.explain: Сеть (net) is the direct object of ставить (to set).

reading.ru: Притчи Соломона, сына Давидова, царя Израиля.
reading.question: Who wrote the book of Proverbs?
options: Solomon, son of David, king of Israel
reading.correct: Solomon, son of David, king of Israel
reading.explain: The text identifies the proverbs as Solomon's, son of David, king of Israel.

reading.question: What is the beginning of wisdom?
reading.explain: The text clearly states that fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

reading.ru: Сын мой, послушай наставления своего отца, и не отвергай поучения своей матери.
reading.question: Whose instruction should a son listen to?
reading.explain: Sons are instructed to listen to both their father's instruction and mother's teaching.

reading.ru: Они будут прекрасным венком на твоей голове и ожерельем на твоей шее.
reading.question: What will be a beautiful crown and necklace?
reading.explain: The text says their instruction will be a garland for your head and chains for your neck.

reading.ru: Мудрость восклицает на улицах, возвышает свой голос на площадях.
reading.question: Where does wisdom call out?
options: In the streets and public squares
reading.correct: In the streets and public squares
reading.explain: Wisdom cries aloud in the streets and raises her voice in the public squares.

reading.ru: Раз они знания возненавидели и страх перед Господом не избрали.
reading.question: What two things did the wicked reject?
options: Knowledge and the fear of the Lord
reading.correct: Knowledge and the fear of the Lord
reading.explain: The text says they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the Lord.
